info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Strategy Retrieval API
info.description: The Product Strategy Retrieval API enables users to access detailed insights into the business direction related to product strategies. By requesting specific parameters, consumers can retrieve valuable data that informs decision-making for product development and market alignment. Typical users include product managers and business analysts seeking to enhance strategic initiatives. This API helps organizations align their product offerings with market demands, ensuring a competitive edge.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific product strategy identified by its unique ID. It provides comprehensive insights into the strategic direction of the product to guide business decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the product strategy for a specific product identified by PROD-700045. It includes relevant parameters that inform the request and shape the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the product strategy details.

GetProductStrategyByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Operations GET request related to product strategy in business direction. It is expected to contain a valid string format.

GetProductStrategyByIdResponse_200.title: Product Strategy Response

sponsorId.description: Unique identifier for the sponsor of the initiative.

planningHorizon.description: String representing the planning horizon period for the initiative.

targetDate.description: Target date for achieving the goals set out in the initiative.

status.description: Current status of the initiative (e.g., active, completed).

recordStatus.description: Status indicating the record state (e.g., active, inactive).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the initiative was last updated.

GetProductStrategyByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for product strategy operations.
